text: Okay, let's get started with the weekly planning meeting. First item on the agenda is the release schedule for version 2.4. Priya said the mobile build is ready for internal testing, but the Android crash on older phones still needs a fix before we ship. Marcus will own that and report back on Thursday. Second item, the customer feedback from the pilot program. Most people liked the offline mode, although several asked for better search across older notes. We agreed to collect the top 10 requests in a shared document by Friday. Finally, the budget review has moved to next Tuesday afternoon, so please send your estimates to Elena before then.

Thanks everyone for joining on short notice. The main reason for this call is the delay with the hardware supplier. They told us the new sensors will arrive three weeks late, which pushes the field trial into November. I suggest we use the remaining prototypes for the lab tests and keep two units in reserve. Sarah, could you check whether the calibration software works with the older firmware? If it does, we can start the stress tests on Monday. Otherwise we need to wait for the firmware update. Let's also make sure the warranty terms in the supplier contract cover the replacement parts.

This is a note about the dishwasher I bought last month. The model is the Bosch series six, serial number ends in 4729. I purchased it at the electronics store downtown on the 12th of September for $649. The warranty is two years from the date of purchase and covers parts and labor. The receipt is in the blue folder in the kitchen drawer. The extended protection plan was offered but I declined it. If the pump makes that grinding noise again, call the service number on the back of the manual.

Quick summary of the incident from last night. Around two in the morning the payment service started returning timeouts because the database connection pool was exhausted. The root cause was a background job that opened a new connection for every record instead of reusing one. We rolled back the deployment at two forty and the error rate went back to normal within five minutes. Action items: add an alert on connection pool usage above 80%, write a regression test for the batch job, and review the other jobs for the same pattern. Jordan will write the post mortem by Wednesday.

Reminder for myself about the garden project. Order two bags of compost and a roll of weed fabric before the weekend. The tomatoes on the south side need stakes, and the irrigation timer should run for fifteen minutes every morning instead of thirty. Ask the neighbor whether we can borrow the ladder to trim the hedge. Also, the apple tree needs pruning in late winter, not now. Check the price of a rain barrel at the hardware store, and remember that the seed catalog discount expires at the end of the month.

Guten Morgen zusammen. Heute besprechen wir den Zeitplan für das neue Projekt. Die erste Version soll bis Ende Oktober fertig sein. Thomas kümmert sich um die Tests auf den Geräten, und Julia schreibt die Dokumentation. Wir haben noch offene Fragen zum Budget, deshalb treffen wir uns am Donnerstag noch einmal mit der Finanzabteilung. Bitte schickt mir eure Aufgabenlisten bis morgen Abend.

Bonjour à tous. Nous allons parler du lancement du produit prévu pour le mois prochain. L'équipe de vente a besoin des nouvelles brochures avant la fin de la semaine. Claire va préparer la présentation pour les clients et Paul s'occupe de la formation du support technique. Il reste un problème avec la traduction de l'application, donc nous devons vérifier tous les textes avant mardi.

Buenos días a todos. El objetivo de esta reunión es revisar el presupuesto del próximo trimestre. Los costos de transporte subieron un 10%, así que tenemos que ajustar los precios. Carmen va a preparar un informe con las opciones y lo presentaremos al director el viernes. También necesitamos contratar a dos personas más para el equipo de atención al cliente.
